message: @opentelemetry/propagator-jaeger is removed in 3.0. Either switch every service to W3CTraceContextPropagator from @opentelemetry/core at the same time (or run both side by side with CompositePropagator while they move), or keep @opentelemetry/propagator-jaeger@^2 and register it by hand after SDK setup.
